private static readonly int ColorPropertyId = Shader.PropertyToID(\"_Color\"); private void Awake() { stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(gcConcatIterations * 4); propertyBlock = new MaterialPropertyBlock(); k < cpuScansPerFrame; k++) { for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { var obj = cachedGameObjects[i]; } } } if (stressDraw && testPrefab != null) { int n = Mathf.Max(1, cubesPerFrame); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) SpawnOne(); } } private void SpawnOne() { GameObject clone; Vector3 pos = UnityEngine.Random.insideUnitSphere * spawnRadius; if (objectPool.Count > 0) { clone = objectPool.Dequeue(); clone.transform.position = pos; clone.transform.rotation = Quaternion.identity; clone.SetActive(true); } else { clone = Instantiate(testPrefab, pos, Quaternion.identity); cachedGameObjects.Add(clone); } if (useUniqueMaterials) { var rend = clone.GetComponent<Renderer>(); if (rend != null) { rend.GetPropertyBlock(propertyBlock); propertyBlock.SetColor(ColorPropertyId, new Color(UnityEngine.Random.value, UnityEngine.Random.value, UnityEngine.Random.value)); rend.SetPropertyBlock(propertyBlock); } } } } }","explicacao_didatica":"O comando FindObjectsOfType e uma busca muito pesada porque a Unity precisa olhar objeto por objeto existente no jogo.
